mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or correlation with SPX returns drops below 0.1 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply chain recovery (INDPRO growth above 0.5% monthly) expands production capacity and supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) consistently signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market recovery (HOUST growth above 0.5% monthly) drives residential construction activity and consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.
